key_insight: Simultaneous neural topology optimization jointly learns state, adjoint, and design fields to produce super-resolution stress-constrained designs at large scales.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets computational bottlenecks in designing material-efficient structures subject to local stress limits.
method: Jointly optimize custom neural networks using continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation.
Combine the design objective, aggregated local stress constraints, and potential energy functionals in one loss.
Distribute spatial partitions across GPUs and accumulate gradients over smaller slices to control peak memory while preserving field continuity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions than a conventional FEM-based approach on 2D benchmarks, plus 3D demonstrations with up to eight million collocation points and eight GPUs.
watch_item: Aggregated stress constraints and neural field approximations warrant independent checks of local peak stresses and constraint satisfaction.
paper_title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
